rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality early/expanded blastocyst consistent with 3AA, notes limits of a single static image, and gives plausible ICM/TE/zona comments without major fabrication; slightly hedged and not highly image-specific.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, male-factor diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, prior cycle history, and lifestyle factors with embryo prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo grade and patient factors; minor issue is somewhat broad probability framing and a few speculative points.

Generally aligns with IVF practice: supports single blastocyst transfer, recognizes limits of morphology, and avoids unnecessary add-ons after one failure; minor deviations include some lifestyle emphasis beyond strict guideline scope.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer management, counseling, lifestyle optimization, and contingency planning for future cycles with appropriate nuance.
